actual: Step 1 FAIL: typing a session title in the Add-session 'Session theme' box and pressing the wizard Close control showed NO dialog — navigated straight to /programs; repeated twice with the same result. The typed title was not saved (reopen showed 'No sessions yet'). Step 2 PASS: after ADDING a session plan ('PRG-037 Session', a real unsaved change — header 'Unsaved changes'), Close DID show the dialog 'Leave without saving?' / 'Your changes on this step are not saved yet.' with 'Keep editing' and 'Leave anyway'. 'Keep editing' returned to the step with the session plan still listed and 'Unsaved changes' still shown; closing again and pressing 'Leave anyway' navigated to /programs and saved nothing. Focus returning to the close control after Keep editing could not be verified. Step 3 FAIL: after reopening and adding the skill 'Off break' (chip shown, 'Unsaved changes'), browser Back navigated to /programs with NO dialog and did NOT save the step — reopening Curriculum showed the skill pool empty again, 'Draft saved 5:59 pm'. Step 4 FAIL: on /programs/new/basics with 'PRG-037 Test Program' typed, browser Back showed NO dialog and did NOT stay — it navigated back to /programs/templates/113/setup/curriculum. No 'PRG-037 Test Program' draft exists, so nothing was created. The guard fires only after a session plan is added, never for typed-but-unadded input, and never on browser Back. UPDATE 17 Nov (PRG-044 side observation): closing Basics with dirty form values DID show the 'Leave without saving?' / 'Your changes on this step are not saved yet.' dialog — so the guard triggers on a dirty step, not on a merely typed-but-unadded sub-form title. The Curriculum session-title box does not mark the step dirty until a session plan is added; browser Back never triggers the guard at all.
expected: Close shows 'Leave without saving?' with 'Your changes on this step are not saved yet.', Keep editing and Leave anyway. Keep editing keeps the text and returns focus to the close control. Leave anyway saves nothing. Browser Back from a later step saves that step once and moves. On /programs/new/basics with typed text and no draft, Back shows the same dialog and the address stays.
steps: Type a session title and press the wizard's close control.
Press Keep editing, then close again and press Leave anyway.
Reopen, type a change, and use the browser Back button.
Open Create program, type a name on Basics, press browser Back.
title: PRG-037: wizard Close and browser Back discard typed input without the 'Leave without saving?' dialog
trail: Batch 3a, 2026-11-17, Cricmax Test_AP, draft template 113 (PRG-021 Test Program). Step 2's capture came out blank — the modal did not render in the print capture; the dialog wording is from the live view.
